title: Rebrand favicon/logo: 'F' → 'd' (same red background), app name 'dash'
description: Change the app favicon and any logo/icon assets from 'F' (Flash) to 'd' (dash) with the same red background color. Find the existing favicon/icon files (likely in apps/desktop/public/ or src-tauri/icons/), update them. Also update any app title strings from 'Flash 8' or similar to 'Dash'. Check: apps/desktop/index.html (title tag, favicon link), apps/desktop/public/ (favicon.ico, icon.png etc), src-tauri/tauri.conf.json (productName), package.json workspace name if relevant.
